subject: Invoice delivery: mirrored copy + ACK header / AP contact
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@nimbleworks.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 3 May 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Invoice delivery / VAT evidence + PO 55722

Hi Sean,

Quick one from AP as we prep to go live with Redwood: can you confirm how invoices will be delivered for our account (NimbleWorks)? Our preferences are: an emailed PDF copy to ap-invoices@nimbleworks.com, plus an SFTP mirror (some of our systems pull the raw XML), and an optional portal opt-in for one-off retrieval.

Two specific asks:
- Can Redwood include a standard header in the invoice metadata (e.g., Invoice-Created-By: Redwood-Platform and an Invoice-Ack-ID header) so our ingestion can auto-ack?
- We need the VAT breakdown line by line and the original PO number on the invoice (PO: 55722).

I'll attach our AP requirements (PDF) and a sample XML layout. If SFTP is possible, we can share a temporary user. Also let us know the fallback if SFTP fails (e.g., email-only delivery).

Thanks — looking to finalize this today so our finance system mapping can go ahead.

Best,
Elena Morales
Head of Finance Operations
NimbleWorks Inc

Attachment: AP_requirements.pdf (PDF, 98KB)
Attachment: sample_invoice_XML_v2.xml (XML, 6KB)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@nimbleworks.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 3 May 2026 10:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery / VAT evidence + PO 55722

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear requirements and the attachments. We can support the flows you describe; summarizing our proposal so we're aligned: 

1) Dual delivery: primary is portal with email copy to ap-invoices@nimbleworks.com (PDF).
2) SFTP mirror of the raw invoice XML pushed once per invoice (we'll put in a retry/backoff for failures).
3) We'll include two additional headers in the outgoing payload: Invoice-Created-By: Redwood-Platform and Invoice-Ack-ID: <uuid> (this is what your ingestion can use to auto-ack).
4) VAT line itemization and PO number will be on every invoice.

Can you confirm: do you want the email copy to include the XML as an attachment, or just the PDF with XML on SFTP? Also confirm SLA for re-issuing corrected invoices (e.g., within 24 hours of request) — we can make that part of our handoff playbook.

I've looped in Marissa (billing ops) and Karthik (integration lead) to scope the SFTP and portal config. If you give the go-ahead I'll create a short mutual action plan and share credentials for the onboarding runbook.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0123

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 3 May 2026 12:48:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery / VAT evidence + PO 55722

Thanks Sean — forwarding the details to ops. Implementation notes below for Connor and Karthik (copying their teams as needed):

- Portal + email copy: portal opt-in will be default-off; we can toggle it per account. Email copy will contain the PDF and a short metadata header in the message body (Invoice-Ack-ID).
- SFTP mirror: Connor, we need an automated push job that drops <account_id>/invoices/YYYYMMDD/<invoice_uuid>.xml and sets file-level metadata with Invoice-Created-By and Invoice-Ack-ID. Please include retry up to 5 times with exponential backoff; if push fails after retries, send an alert to billing-ops and fallback to sending XML as email attachment to ap-invoices@nimbleworks.com.
- VAT and PO: our invoice generator will ensure VAT lines are explicit (tax_base, tax_rate, tax_amount) and put the customer PO in the Invoice reference field.

Elena — one doc note: the XML sample you provided is close to our expected schema but we will send an example output so your team can confirm field mapping. Also, on re-issuance SLA: ops proposes 48 hours for corrected invoices during onboarding and 24 hours after steady state. If NimbleWorks needs 24/24 during onboarding we can discuss in the MOP.

Marissa Cole
Billing Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Sean / Marissa — thanks for the quick turnaround. We accept the dual-delivery flow and the Invoice-Ack-ID header; the SFTP mirror is desirable. A couple of final points before we sign off: 

- PO 55722 should be reflected in the reference field; confirmed.
- Please include the XML as an email attachment for the first two invoices while we validate mapping on our side; after that we can switch to SFTP-only for XML.
- For re-issue SLA: we need corrected invoices within 24 hours during onboarding. If operations need a formal MOP to commit to that, please share and we'll review.

I'll open a secure upload with temporary SFTP credentials and send them to marissa@redwoodinference.com shortly. After that, go ahead and share the sample output invoice (PDF + XML) so we can finish mapping.

Best,
Elena Morales
Head of Finance Operations
NimbleWorks Inc
